decisions.decision: WR-02 fix: added entriesForAllLocales() helper in sitemap.ts instead of reusing entriesFor() for the /products and /insights hub pages
decisions.rationale: entriesFor() calls getTranslatedLocales(collection, slug) which expects a real CMS document (Pages/Products/Insights) to check translation status against. /products and /insights are code-only listing routes with no backing CMS doc — they render unconditionally in all 4 locales per [locale]/layout.tsx's generateStaticParams — so they need an ungated, locale-invariant entry instead.

decisions.decision: WR-01 fix: removed the category breadcrumb entry entirely rather than making its url field optional
decisions.rationale: No category archive page exists to link to; the shared breadcrumbJsonLd() builder's type signature requires a non-optional url on every item. Omitting the entry (Products > Product Name, 2 levels) was simpler than touching the shared builder's type for one caller.

The old assertion `entries.some(url.includes('insights')) === false` was written before the WR-02 fix, when /insights only appeared via article detail pages. Now the /insights hub is always present (by design), so the test needed to distinguish 'no article detail entries' (url.includes('/insights/') === false) from 'hub entry present' (url === BASE+'/insights' === true). Not a test weakening — it now asserts the correct, more specific behavior.
